lyrics.original: Runaway my baby, 나 Dancing with somebody
lyrics.romanization: runaway my baby na, dancing with somebody
lyrics.english: Runaway my baby, me, Dancing with somebody

lyrics.original: 맘대로 나가지, 또 없지 난 중간이
lyrics.romanization: mamdaero nagaji, tto eopji nan junggani
lyrics.english: I go my own way again, There’s no one else I’m in the middle

lyrics.romanization: nareul wirohadeut balge binnaji dari
lyrics.english: It shines brightly as if comforting me

lyrics.romanization: yeojeonhi nal chaja tto
lyrics.english: The moon still comes looking for me again

lyrics.original: 거절은 안 해 난 go go go
lyrics.romanization: geojeoreun an hae nan go go go
lyrics.english: I don’t refuse it, I go go go

lyrics.original: 갇혀 있던 미로, 네 말은 다시 울려 왜
lyrics.romanization: gathyeo itdeon miro, ne mareun dasi ullyeo wae
lyrics.english: The maze I was trapped in, Your words echo again, why?

lyrics.romanization: (mareun dasi ullyeo wae)
heuteojyeotdeon gido, yeojeonhi jantteuk kkoeyeotne
lyrics.english: The prayer that had scattered, Is still all tangled up

lyrics.romanization: Oh baby she go runaway, Now she on her way

lyrics.original: 자꾸 반복해 난 기를 쓰고 왜
lyrics.romanization: jakku banbokhae nan gireul sseugo wae
lyrics.english: I keep repeating it, why do I try so hard?

lyrics.romanization: Oh baby she go runaway, Now she on her way

lyrics.original: 혼자가 돼가 난 길을 잃은 채
lyrics.romanization: honjaga dwaega nan gireul ireun chae
lyrics.english: I’m becoming alone, lost as I am

lyrics.original: Baby don’t runaway, 내게 don’t runaway
lyrics.romanization: baby don’t runaway, naege don’t runaway
lyrics.english: Baby don’t runaway, Don’t runaway from me

lyrics.english: You run away without your wings, Oh oh
